records.manualArithmetic: No assigned numerical exercise. A linear steady slab profile gives Fourier power-lambda*A*dT/dx=lambda*A(Th-Tc)/s. Double thickness halves power; double area and thickness cancel. Reviewer toy:lambda1/2W/(mK),area2m²,deltaT20K,s1/10m gives200W. Density contrast1000minus990kg/m³ over1L in assignedg10 gives upwardbuoyancy1/10N as a possible natural-convection driver. Radiation uses absolute fourth powers: equalbody/environmentT givesnetzero, doubledbodyT versusunchangedambient gives15ambient emissionunits net, whileemissionalone scales16. Shifting the arbitrary temperature origin changes the expression; Celsius cannot replacekelvin.
records.physicalAssumptions: One-dimensional homogeneous slab,positiveconstant/effectiveconductivity,steadyfixedfacetemperatures,negligiblelateral losses,positiveelapsedtime. Th>Tc fixespositiveconductedpower. Naturalconvectionneedsgravityanddensitycontrast;not everyhotparcelnecessarilyrises. Greybodyconstantemissivity[0,1] inlargeisothermalenclosure,absolute temperatures,netoutward sign. Absorption/emissionmaybothnonzerowhilenetzero. Electromagnetictransportdoesnotneedmaterialmedium.

Reversibleisotherm integratesnRT/V toexactnRTln2 forvolume doubling;source doesnot demandadecimal log. AdiabaticQ0 andpositiveCv givecooling ifWoutpositive. IntegratingCv*dT+RT*dV/V=0 yieldsTV^(R/Cv) constant andpV^gamma invariant,gamma1+R/Cv>1. Adiabaticlogarithmicslope-gamma issteeperthanisothermal-1. Reviewer toy monatomicgamma5/3,eightfoldV yieldsT/4,p/32 instead ofisothermp/8;32kPa1L to1kPa8L gives36Jwork. FrictionF overdistanceD dissipatesFD even as speedtendszero,so slowalone isnotreversible.
records.physicalAssumptions: EquilibriumstatesalongquasistaticpVpaths. Closedfixedcompositionidealgas,positiveT,V,n andpositiveheatcapacities. Reversibleadiabaticpowerlawadditionallyconstantmolarcapacitiesandnodissipation;Q0alone isnot sufficientforpVgamma. Isothermalreversibleexpansionrequirescompensatingheat;rapidpathneednot haveuniforminternalp. Slowmotionwithfrictioncanstillbeirreversible,as sourcenotes. Symbolicln2 is anexactresultofareviewerextension,not ademandeddecimalanswer.
